WESTERN PROVINCE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL
Minute of the Western Provincial Public Management Assistants’ ServiceAmendment No. 01

THE Minute of the Western Provincial Public Management Assistants’ Service published in the Gazette ExtraordinaryNo. 1898/5 dated 19th January, 2015 of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka is amended in the following manner.
1. The Section 7.3.2.3 is removed and substituted by the following Section
7.3.2.3 Experience :

Shall have completed active and satisfactory service of at least 05 years in a permanent post in the WesternProvincial Public Service as at the prescribed date, which fact shall be certified by the Head of the Department.(Clarifications under this section will remain unchanged)
2. The following Section is included as a serial number (iv) at the end of the Sub sections under the Section 7.3.2.5
7.3.2.5 Other
(iv) Shall have completed a satisfactory Service Period of five years immediately preceding the prescribed date.
3. The Section 8.3 is removed and substituted by the following Section
8.3 Authority for conducting Examination: the Commissioner General of Examinations or an institution authorizedby the Western Provincial Public Service Commission.
4. The Section (a) (iii) of the para 10.3.1.1 is removed and substituted by the following Section

(iii) shall be an officer who has obtained a degree from a University recognized by the University Grants Commissionand has completed an active and satisfactory service period of five years in the service.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk1A – PG3838 – 08 (12/2017)

5. The para 10.3.1.2 is removed and substituted by the following para 10.3.1.2 Method of Promotion

Appointments equivalent to 50% of the total vacancies in Supra Grade shall be made on the results of the limitedcompetitive examination. Candidates should obtain at least 40 marks for each subject relevant to the examinationfor passing the limited competitive examination. The candidates who have satisfied the qualifications shall beappointed after verifying their qualifications by an interview board appointed by the Western Provincial PublicService Commission. The interview shall strictly be for examination of certificates by which the qualifications of thecandidates are proved and no marks shall be allocated in this regard.(Syllabus and the marking scheme is given in annex 09).
6. The para 10.3.2.2 is removed and substituted by the following para 10.3.2.2 Method of Promotion

Appointments equivalent to 50% of the total vacancies in Supra Grade shall be made on the basis of merit. For thispurpose candidates should pass an Aptitude Test conducted by the Commissioner General of Examinations onbehalf of the Western Provincial Public Service Commission, obtaining at least 40 marks for each subject. Priorityshall be determined on the results of the said examination and on the order of the aggregate of marks allocated onthe basis of seniority and experience by the board appointed by the Western Provincial Public Service Commission.Candidates shall appear for an interview held by a board appointed by the Western Provincial Public ServiceCommission for verification of qualifications. No marks shall be allocated at that interview. (Annex 10)
7. The Note under the Annex 04 is replaced by the following part
Note 01

Officers who have satisfied the following requirements of the Computer Test relevant Efficiency Bar Examination ofGrade III of the Western Provincial Public Management Assistants’ Service shall be exempted.
01. Officers who have followed computer courses offered by the following institutions, of which the syllabus issimilar to the computer course indicated in the Service Minute.

a. Sri Lanka Institute of Development Administrationb. National Apprentice and Industrial Training Authorityc. Vocational Training Authority of Sri Lankad. Courses conducted by Technical Colleges and Technological Colleges which function under the Departmentof Technical Education and Training.e. Universities or other institutions recognized by the University Grants Commissionf. National Youth Council.

02. Officers who have obtained a degree in Computer Science from an university recognized by the UniversityGrants Commission or officers who have followed Computer Science as a main subject for the degree.
Note 02

Officers who have satisfied the qualifications indicated under the Note in the Annex 04 of the Minute of theWestern Provincial Public Management Assistants’ Service No. 1898/5 dated 19.01.2015 shall also be exemptedfrom the Computer Test for a period of two years from the date on which the Gazette containing these revisions ispublished.
K. C. LOGESWARAN,Governor of the Western Province
